name: Solomon Islands
snapshot: Parliament ousted Jeremiah Manele in a May 2026 no-confidence vote and chose opposition leader Matthew Wale, in a country courted by both China and Australia.
culture: The Solomon Islands include nearly 1,000 islands and some 70 languages, with Solomon Pidgin as a common tongue. Shell money is still used for bride price in Malaita. Panpipe ensembles are a distinctive musical tradition. Guadalcanal was the scene of one of the Pacific War's fiercest battles.
society: Logging, fishing and subsistence farming dominate, and forests are being cleared fast. Ethnic tensions between people from Malaita and Guadalcanal led to violence from 1998 to 2003 and an Australian-led intervention. A 2022 security pact with China alarmed Australia and the US.
baseline: Manele, foreign minister under Manasseh Sogavare, became prime minister in 2024. After coalition splits, he lost a no-confidence vote on 7 May 2026 by 26 votes to 22, and parliament elected Matthew Wale as prime minister on 15 May.

leaders.state: King Charles III, represented by a governor-general
leaders.gov: Prime Minister Matthew Wale, since May 2026
